proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3104.2 kalya gives Prakrit kallaṃ/kalhiṃ and Hindi kal for yesterday/tomorrow, with long-vowel forms in Awadhi, Bengali, Gujarati and Marathi. The two temporal senses are explicitly compatible; source records retain their distinct elicited meanings. The specific short-vowel Sanskrit branch is selected, while local vowel length and final-e need review.
